checks.name: recorded_support
details: Recorded judgment only; no new support evaluation.
Upper-source suppression improves the core but leaves blue residual; large two-source changes can fit selected B/C means while producing excessive red emission and worse all-data Q.
Tested smooth longitude maps, faster radial flow and stellar/calibration proxies do not establish a solution. Uniform LOS offsets are pixel-sensitive.
Extended absorbing gas with low n3/n2 is a motivated structural hypothesis, but its population/energy/flow realization and separation from stellar/reduction effects are unverified.
The target was selected from the same observations; uncalibrated covariance and no repeated complete blue support preclude a unique physical attribution.
